messages:
Priya Menon: Hi team — I updated my home address in Workday on 2025-11-02 (moved from CA to OR). My last paycheck (2025-11-15) still has CA state withholding and includes a CA SDI deduction. Can we check whether payroll picked up the address change and whether a retro correction is possible? Also want OR mailing for W-2.

Tomas Alvarez: @Priya thanks for the heads up. Can you confirm the exact date you updated it in Workday and send the confirmation email screenshot? We need that for audit trail before we make retro changes.

Priya Menon: I made the change on 2025-11-02 and I have the Workday confirmation. Uploading screenshot now.

Benji Carter: Looping payroll in. @Tomas @Priya two options: 1) change withholding going forward only, 2) run retro adjustments for the 11/15 payrun (and any earlier ones if needed), or 3) leave and handle on tax filing. Typically we prefer retro if the employee requests it and the amounts are material. Please provide employee ID and last4.

Priya Menon: Employee ID 90123, last4 9876. I'd like a retro if it's straightforward — Oregon shouldn't withhold CA SDI.

Elena (tax): Note that CA SDI can be sticky for midyear moves. If payroll corrects the amounts now, we may not need a W-2c. If totals change for state wages/withholding boxes, payroll will issue a corrected W-2.

Benji Carter: I pulled the record. Workday address updated 2025-11-02 but payroll sync happened after the 11/15 cutoff. We'll: 1) update payroll address to OR, 2) submit a retro for payrun 2025-11-15 to remove CA SDI and adjust state withholding to OR, 3) recalc nets and YTDs, 4) confirm whether W-2 boxes change.

payroll-bot: Retro job queued: job id retro-2025-90123-11. ETA ~20m.

Tomas Alvarez: Priya — quick Q on W-2 mailing: do you want physical W-2 mailed to OR address or to the old CA address (we can also hold)?

Priya Menon: Please use OR address on file. No holding.

payroll-bot: Retro job retro-2025-90123-11 completed. Results: CA SDI removed for 11/15 run, state withholding adjusted to OR for that run. Net pay increased by $8.17 (employee received small reimbursement). Year-to-date state withholding totals updated. W-2 mailing address updated to OR. No W-2c needed (state box totals adjusted but no federal/state mismatch).

Benji Carter: I added a payroll note and emailed a summary to Priya. Command run:
```
payrollctl adjust --emp 90123 --runs 2025-11-15 --remove-deduction CA-SDI --apply-state OR --note "midyear state move; Workday updated 11/02"
```

Priya Menon: Thank you all! Can I get a one-line confirmation email for my records that shows the payroll job id and what changed?

Tomas Alvarez: Yup — you'll have the email from Benji with job id retro-2025-90123-11 and the payrun summary. Closing the loop here but DM if anything else pops up. :wave:
